column3: The Hebrew repeats “heads of the fathers” for the tribal representatives and has no explicit word “other”; BSB says “the heads of the other tribes.”
The Hebrew says “by the hand of Moses”; BSB says “through Moses.”
The Hebrew says “according to the mouth of the LORD”; BSB says “by the command of the LORD.”
The Hebrew does not explicitly call this lot “first” in this verse; BSB supplies “first.”
The Hebrew explicitly mentions the clans of Ephraim’s tribe; BSB lists only the tribes.
The Hebrew explicitly mentions the clans of Issachar’s tribe; BSB lists only the tribes.
The Hebrew explicitly says “according to their clans”; BSB does not repeat that phrase here.
The Hebrew says “by the hand of Moses” and explicitly names the lot at the end; BSB uses “through Moses” and incorporates the lot in “allotted.”
The Hebrew says the cities were given and then that one would call them by name; BSB combines this as “designated these cities by name.”

The Hebrew explicitly gives pastureland with each of Jattir and Eshtemoa; BSB lists the town names here, with the pasturelands included collectively in the surrounding passage.
